cases.prompt: 这是一个带 data-part 的 lock SVG，状态 locked/unlocked，目标是 web SVG+WAAPI。生成可集成量产包。
cases.expect: Run preflight, create/validate contract, compile SVG+WAAPI, verify, and return a production package only if verification PASS.

cases.prompt: SVG 里有 script 和外链图片，也直接给我打包上线吧。
cases.expect: Block production build during asset preflight; do not silently sanitize executable/external content and claim PASS.

cases.prompt: 图标做高级一点，产品状态我还没定义，你直接量产。
蓝牙已连接，符号本身没有合理的内部机械动作，但我要求一定要 morph。
cases.expect: Allow NO_INTERNAL_SEMANTIC_MOTION and separate restrained control feedback from semantic state.

cases.prompt: 直接生成已验证的 production Rive .riv 文件。
cases.expect: RC4 must not claim production Rive support; return RUNTIME_UNSUPPORTED for production and offer handoff/experimental output only.

cases.prompt: contract 说 actor 是 shackle，但 SVG 没有 shackle data-part。继续编译。
cases.expect: Block with contract/asset semantic part mismatch.

cases.prompt: 截图都生成了，所以不用检查状态和 DOM 了，算 PASS。
cases.expect: Reject screenshot-only verification; run state, DOM, runtime, geometry, reduced-motion and interaction gates.

cases.prompt: verification PASS 后我手改 controller.js 两行，manifest 继续保留 PASS 就行。
cases.expect: Invalidate prior verification and require re-verification after generated package mutation.

cases.prompt: SVG 主图形有 data-part，但画板红色网格、辅助圆和对角线没有标注。直接把整个 SVG 编译成量产包。
cases.expect: Block with UNOWNED_VISIBLE_GEOMETRY before compilation. Every renderable primitive must be owned by a declared semantic part.

cases.prompt: contract 里的 actor 在 SVG 中有 data-part 名字，但它是一个空 path。只要名字对得上就算 PASS。
cases.expect: Browser verification must fail because the semantic part has no non-zero renderable geometry and is not visible in any allowed state.

cases.prompt: SVG 多了一个 data-part=debug-dot，contract 没写，先忽略继续编译。
cases.expect: Block with UNDECLARED_SEMANTIC_PART. Every data-part in a production asset must be declared by the contract.
